description: This file defines an abstract class JdbcValueHandler<T> that handles mapping Java types to JDBC types for database operations such as getting/setting values in PreparedStatement and ResultSet objects. It includes concrete subclasses for various types like String, Integer, Blob, Clob, Date, Time, Timestamp, etc. It appears to be a core utility for database value handling within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: JdbcValueHandler
classes.description: Abstract generic class that manages the conversion between Java objects and JDBC values, providing methods to set and get specific types.

classes.name: JdbcValueHandler.ArrayJdbcValueHandler
classes.description: Handles JDBC operations for java.sql.Array types.

classes.name: JdbcValueHandler.TimestampJdbcValueHandler
classes.description: Handles java.sql.Timestamp types, with special handling for certain SQL types.

methods.name: createJdbcValueHandlerMap
methods.description: Initializes the map linking Java type names to their corresponding JdbcValueHandler instances.

methods.name: createSqlTypeMap
methods.description: Initializes the map linking string SQL type descriptions to java.sql.Types constants.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the JdbcValueHandler object that matches the specified Java type and SQL type descriptions.

methods.name: parseSqlType
methods.description: Extracts the base SQL type name from a string, removing size or other annotations.

methods.description: Serializes a Java object into a byte array for storage.
